title: PEA-DPO: Perception-Enhanced Alignment Direct Preference Optimization for MLLMs Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.19598v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as an effective approach for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. However, its adaptation to multimodal settings remains unexplored. Through representational analysis, we identify a key limitation in multimodal preference optimization, which we term visual insensitivity: models often fail to distinguish between images and those with critical visual context removed.
